s.note: the seed and grain offering the ants gather
s.how: Mix 60g each of sunflower seeds, pepitas, linseeds and sesame seeds with 40g chia, a pinch of salt and 250ml water. Rest 15 minutes, spread thin and bake at 160C for an hour until crunchy. Break into shards. An offering fit for any colony.

s.note: the berries the ants carry across Ant Island
s.how: Thread blueberries, raspberries, small cubes of feta and a mint leaf onto toothpicks. Lay them out on a long platter in neat marching lines, like ants on the way to the harvest.

m.how: Fry 150g diced bacon, then soften a diced onion. Add 500g diced potatoes, 2 cans of corn, thyme and 1L water and simmer 20 minutes. Stir in 150ml cream and blitz a little for body. Serve topped with chives.

w.note: Heimlich the caterpillar finally getting his wings
w.how: Beat 250g butter with 100g sugar, then mix in 350g flour. Roll out and cut into butterfly shapes. Bake at 160C for 15 minutes and cool. Ice in bright colours with icing sugar and food colouring. One day, a beautiful butterfly.

d.note: the giant dewdrops on the leaves
d.how: Blend a Lebanese cucumber with a handful of mint, the juice of 2 limes and 2 tbsp sugar. Strain into a jug and pour over ice. Top with soda water. Fresh as a dewdrop that looks huge to a very small bug.
